Alex - people-ops: Heads-up — performance review blackout window next Mon 00:00 PDT to Wed 23:59 PDT. Please confirm reviewer coverage and mentor check-ins.
Maya Chen: Got it. I'll cover Eng infra reviews for Tue afternoon. Do we have a swap process if someone is OOO?
Jamal Ortiz: Need swap flow. I have an LOA overlap Tue-Wed morning, can swap with @Maya. How do we update forms?
Alex - people-ops: Swap flow = DM me + update the 'Reviewer swap' column in the spreadsheet. We'll mirror to HR. Link: https://redwood.example.com/review-ops/swap-policy
Priya Patel: When exactly do forms lock? I have a few late-fill items for my ICs.
Alex - people-ops: Forms lock Wed 23:59 PDT automatically. If you need an exception, request by Tue 18:00 in this thread + brief reason. Exceptions for caregiving or LOA handled case-by-case.
Maya Chen: For manager-mentor check-ins, can we use the buddy system? I'd pair new managers with senior PMs for a 30-min sync.
Alex - people-ops: Love that — add "mentor check-in" to the calendar invite template. Example blurb to send to teams:
```
Hi team — quick reminder: book a 30-min mentor check-in before Wed end to review drafts and questions. Reply here if you need a buddy.
```
Jamal Ortiz: +1 for the template. Also requesting reviewer swap: I'm swapping with @Maya — @Alex updated the sheet.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: review forms deadline in 48 hours. https://redwood.example.com/forms (auto)
Priya Patel: One more Q — who approves last-minute calibration slots? I might need a 1-hr slot Thursday AM.
Alex - people-ops: Calibration chair (Samir) approves ad-hoc slots. CC Samir in your request or drop into calibration queue: #calibration-requests.
Maya Chen: Confirmed my swaps and mentors. Thanks!
Jamal Ortiz: Done. Thanks all.
Alex - people-ops: We'll run one final drop-in hour Wed 10:00 PDT — I'll post the calendar invite shortly. :thumbsup:
people-ops-bot: Event created: Final Review Drop-in — Wed 10:00 PDT. (auto)
